title: Marguerite and the Crown
author: Oscar Montrose
blurb: Felix Crane, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must reforge a broken covenant between realms, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
